Hi Brad! I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH of them are free for a 30-minute slot:

- Monday: 9:00-9:30, 15:00-15:30
- Tuesday: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00 (multiple slots), 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 9:00-9:30, 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00 (multiple slots)
- Thursday: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00 (multiple slots), 13:30-14:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these times work for them? Or share their availability so we can find overlap.
